scope: General application and optional responder-training requirements resolved by CI.
removal_condition: Remove only if the advisory is withdrawn or after adopting a released compatible Accelerate version declared unaffected/fixed; scanner-feed disappearance alone is not remediation.

accepted_risks.upstream_constraint: CVE-2026-69112 names Accelerate through 1.14.0 and declares no fixed release. On 2026-09-09 the official 1.15.0 wheel still joined unvalidated weight_map values to checkpoint_folder in accelerate/utils/modeling.py, so this project conservatively carries the same risk forward. GitHub's advisory has no supported-ecosystem package mapping, so pip-audit feeds may omit it even while the reviewed code-level risk remains.
mitigations: Load only repository-pinned or SHA-256-inventoried model directories and checkpoint shards selected by the trusted operator.
Do not accept model paths, checkpoint indexes, shard paths, FIFOs, or other model artifacts from browser/API request payloads.
Keep model loading local and single-operator; this exception does not authorize a public multi-tenant model-loading service.
The drift audit fails on any package/version/advisory change and makes a stale exception fail once the finding disappears.

accepted_risks.upstream_constraint: All seventeen advisories are fixed in filelock 4.2.1, and every fixed release requires Python >= 3.11. The CI floor job resolves the declared minimum, Python 3.10, where 4.1.0 is the newest installable release. Python >= 3.11 installs require the fixed release (pyproject.toml and requirements.txt).
mitigations: Python 3.11+ environments, including the deployed Python 3.12 runtime, require the fixed filelock >= 4.2.1.

Each advisory needs another local user who can write next to or into the project's lock files, including a ReadWriteLock database (or a Windows host): run the system under a dedicated account with private model and Hugging Face cache directories that untrusted local users cannot write to.
Remove this exception when the supported Python floor is raised to 3.11.
